Exploratory study of the public 2023 Stack Overflow Developer Survey.

How developers describe AI adoption

An analysis of reported AI usage, benefits and sentiment across age and programming-experience groups.

Python · pandas · NumPy · Matplotlib · Seaborn

The question

AI adoption is not described by a single average developer profile.

The work

  • Clean survey fields and handle missing responses.
  • Compare AI selection categories across programming experience.
  • Visualize perceived benefits and sentiment across age groups.

What the repository demonstrates

  • Three original survey figures and a companion written article communicate the findings.

What I learned

  • Turn survey data into accessible comparisons while distinguishing association from causation.

Project context

  • Observational and self-reported survey data; no causal claim about age or experience.
Source references

This is a curated local case study based on the public project repository, not a rerun of the original analysis.

  • DS_Stackoverflow_survey_results_public
